What should be the first step I should take when preparing to live, at least partially, off the grid?

Do a test run for a month and find out just how little you actually need or want to survive. Also, pick a place with lots of water, but is above the high water mark for the area. It doesn't matter if its every year or every 500 years. If there is a high water mark, eventually there will be a flood and you will regret living in a flood plane. Never build in a flood plane.

Also, consider a hobbit home buried into a mountain side- as long as its not in a flood plane.
Energy storage system and a water source.
Be debt free and stay that way. You wouldn't want someone using your debts to leverage you back onto the grid.

Location is everything. You need a place where you can have access to water, space to cultivate food and the ability to generate your own energy.

So I'd say the first step is acquire some land suitable for the aforementioned goals.
A little veggie or fruit garden is a good start. There aren't many places where you can't do this. Many will grow in a highrise window sill even.

Meter your electricity and see how little you can live off. Same for freshwater and fuel (if your heating/kitchen isn't electric). Maybe take a couple of first aid courses and learn some survival stuff.
